head: GiggleCam camera app gets kids to look at the lens, made for iPhone Duo
dek: GiggleCam is a new camera app that plays a silly animation next to the lens, like a dancing cheese shouting "Say cheese!", so children look at the camera. It was #56 in Photo & Video on the US App Store's paid chart on 13 November.
details: On the iPhone Duo the animation plays on the back screen beside the rear cameras while you frame the shot inside; on other iPhones it works with the selfie camera. It has 12 sayings, googly eyes and other moving things, G-rated GIF search, photo and video, every lens and a 3-second timer. It costs 2.99 dollars, has no accounts or ads, needs iOS 27, is made by Eric Hernandez and came out on 12 November.
where: iPhone, App Store, 2.99 dollars, iOS 27 or later
means: If your kids never look at the camera, this app gives them something to look at right where the lens is.
todo: Check that your iPhone runs iOS 27 before you buy it.
thumb_words: GIGGLECAM MAKES KIDS LOOK AT THE CAMERA
